result.title: Algorithm Distillation for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Safe in-context reinforcement learning (Safe ICRL) asks a policy with fixed parameters to improve on an unseen constrained task from its interaction history while aiming to keep its cost within a budget. Prior work studied Safe ICRL on five benchmarks in three families: a grid world with a hidden goal and obstacles (DarkRoom), continuous navigation where goals and hazards stay invisible until reached (PointGoal, CarGoal), and locomotion with a hidden velocity limit (HalfCheetah, Ant). Safe Algorithm Distillation (Safe AD), trained on the learning histories of a safe RL algorithm, has shown adaptation failures in prior evaluations. For example, in the locomotion tasks its return stays below zero, and it rarely reaches the goal in CarGoal. We revisit two parts of Safe AD. First, we distill a budget-aware teacher with two phases. It searches for the hidden task, exploring more when more budget remains. After its first reward or cost, an expert policy exploits the task within the remaining budget. We collect the teacher's histories under fixed or dynamic budgets. Dynamic budgets increase the occupancy entropy of the return and budget inputs in every environment, and at test time they improve return and lower cost in DarkRoom and HalfCheetah. Second, we propose A-Lag, a test-time adjustment that reweights the distilled policy's actions by their predicted cost, with an adaptive Lagrange multiplier that is updated from the costs observed. In our experiments, A-Lag had lower mean episode cost than Safe AD in all five environments, with lower mean final return in four.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究安全 in-context RL 中的算法蒸馏：先蒸馏一个感知预算的两阶段教师（预算越充裕探索越多，首次获得回报或成本后转为利用），并在测试时用 A-Lag 按预测成本对蒸馏策略的动作重加权，以改善五个约束任务上的回报与成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 「剩余预算决定探索、一旦获得证据即转为利用」及测试时按预测成本调节动作，可能为 LVR 中证据获取与停止决策、测试时状态调节提供概念线索，但论文无视觉或多模态成分，迁移需较多核查。
